rubric.role_summary: Staff-level, hands-on engineering role optimizing large language model inference for production customer deployments, including serving architecture, profiling, kernel-level performance analysis, and latency, throughput, and cost improvements.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Staff-level, hands-on engineering role optimizing large language model inference for production customer deployments, including serving architecture, profiling, kernel-level performance analysis, and latency, throughput, and cost improvements.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- A Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
- Hands-on experience shipping production code in one or more general-purpose languages.
- Familiarity with methods for optimizing LLM inference for high throughput and low latency.
- Experience with modern LLM serving frameworks such as vLLM or SGLang.
- Knowledge of GPU architecture and behavior.
- Hands-on experience with large language models.
- Working knowledge of AI/ML pipelines and the full process of developing and deploying ML models.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Python experience is strongly preferred among general-purpose languages.
- Track record of improving software-system performance, especially for LLMs.
- Experience with CUDA or comparable technologies.
- Record of building and shipping AI/ML inference systems.
- Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
- Prior experience building or tuning AI/ML projects, particularly in customer-facing work.
- Experience with modern LLM serving frameworks and profiling and analyzing performance down to the kernel level; vLLM and SGLang are examples, not both required.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas.
